root_idea.summary: The root centers on leaving something unattended, usually through inattention and sometimes deliberately, and hence on absent awareness or heedlessness.
root_idea.development: From neglecting a matter, the root extends to being unaware or heedless of it. It also describes things left without identifying marks, signs, brands, or known distinction, yielding senses such as trackless land, unmarked animals, and inexperienced or unknown persons.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The inflected QAC form is normalized to the Form I perfect citation form غَفَلَ.
The inflected QAC form is normalized to the Form IV perfect citation form أَغْفَلَ.
Presented under the singular active-participle citation form غَافِلٌ.
The feminine plural active participle is represented under the normalized singular active-participle headword غَافِلٌ.
غَفْلَةٌ is an independently attested verbal noun and noun.

senses.definition: To be unmindful, unaware, heedless, or neglectful of something; to fail to attend to it.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence uses the construction غَفَلَ عَنْ and concerns neglect or inattention to something, including neglect that may occur despite remembering the matter or may be deliberate.

senses.definition: To cause someone to be heedless, unaware, forgetful, or neglectful of something.
senses.usage_conditions: A causative construction; it may take the object of heedlessness with عَنْ. The Quranic usage concerns making or leaving a person heedless of remembrance or truth.

senses.definition: To leave a heart without faith inscribed in it, or thereby render it heedless of divine remembrance.
senses.usage_conditions: A Quran-specific interpretive construction in أَغْفَلْنَا قَلْبَهُ عَنْ ذِكْرِنَا; this is a more specific formulation of the causative sense, expressed through the imagery of writing faith in the heart.

senses.definition: Unmindful, unaware, heedless, or neglectful; lacking attention or requisite cognizance of a matter.
senses.usage_conditions: Used predicatively or substantivally of one who is not attending to, aware of, or vigilant toward something. The Quranic forms include masculine and feminine inflections and do not impose a restriction on the kind of object or matter concerned.

senses.definition: Heedlessness, inattention, or unawareness arising from insufficient vigilance or consideration.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for a state of being unaware or inattentive, including being in heedlessness, arriving or acting at an unawares moment, or neglecting something; the state may sometimes involve intentional neglect.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone unmindful, forgetful, heedless, or inadvertent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II causative use distinct from the Quran-attested Form I and Form IV entries.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To suffice one's companion in an affair while the companion is unmindful or unoccupied by it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form II construction concerning taking care of an affair on behalf of an inattentive companion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To conceal a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate lexical use reported for the Form II headword.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To act with someone in the manner of one who is unmindful, heedless, or inadvertent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form III reciprocal or interactional construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the expression مَا أَغْفَلَهُ عَنْكَ شَيْئًا, to dismiss doubt concerning him about anything.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic Form IV expression rather than the ordinary causative construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strike or light upon someone while he is unmindful.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form IV use describing action occurring upon a heedless person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To call or name someone heedless, or to render him stupid or foolish.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV use involving designation or the attribution of deficient intelligence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask someone for or about a thing while he is occupied, without waiting until he is free.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized transitive Form IV construction concerning the timing of a request.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To leave a beast unbranded and not mark it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV construction with an animal as object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To watch for someone's unmindfulness, forgetfulness, negligence, or inadvertence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form V construction, also used with عَنْ in this sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To feign being unmindful, forgetful, neglectful, or heedless; to act intentionally as though unaware.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form VI reflexive or performative use in which the apparent heedlessness may be assumed rather than real.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be deceived or circumvented while in a state of unmindfulness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate Form VI result or passive-like use reported alongside the feigned-heedlessness sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land or a road without cultivation or waymarks; a trackless or waterless expanse in which no known sign or trace guides a person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of places lacking identifying or guiding marks.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An unmarked gaming arrow with no distinguishing notch, assigned portion, or fine.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical term for a gaming arrow lacking the marks that determine its allotment or penalty.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An unbranded beast, especially an unbranded she-camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may also describe an animal left without a brand for fiscal or customary purposes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel or other livestock animal that yields no milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural use is reported for camels or cattle with this condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A copy of the Qur'an lacking the sectional or other distinguishing signs customarily added to the script.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical description of an unmarked manuscript; it is not assigned to a supplied QAC form group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An anonymous book or writing, unknown-authored poetry, or an unknown and unnamed poet.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used when authorship or identity is not supplied or known.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An inexperienced or undistinguished man whose benefit, harm, claims to honor, or possessions are not known.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A social description of someone not established by experience, reputation, or identifiable distinction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The soft or furry portions of a camel's hair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical or zoological use, reported especially in the plural.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Abundance and ample, high-quality means of subsistence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression فِي غَفَلٍ مِنْ عَيْشِهِ, describing a state of plentiful livelihood.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel that does not take fright or flee, does not hold back from her young, and does not mind who milks her.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of a particularly docile, unresisting she-camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One possessing camels that are not branded.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active-participial nominal referring to ownership of unmarked camels.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The tuft of hair beneath the lower lip.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical noun, especially in the context of washing it during ritual ablution.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One made unmindful; by extension, a simpleton or a person devoid of intelligence, sagacity, skill, or natural understanding.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The concrete characterization as a simpleton is a derived lexical extension of being made heedless.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Causative heedlessness plus strike and labeling extensions.
Unmarked road is covered by the broader trackless-place meaning.
Anatomical tuft beneath the lower lip.

cautions: The Form I QAC occurrence is an inflected imperfect form, so the public headword is normalized to غَفَلَ; the Form IV occurrence is likewise normalized to أَغْفَلَ.

The interpretation of أَغْفَلْنَا قَلْبَهُ عَنْ ذِكْرِنَا as leaving faith unwritten in the heart is preserved as a distinct Quranic construction because it is explicitly supplied, alongside the broader causative interpretation.

The classical غُفْلٌ entry includes an unmarked Qur'an manuscript, but this remains a Classical Arabic meaning rather than a separate Quranic form because no corresponding QAC غُفْلٌ form group is supplied.
